text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, got some fresh laces on my 
shoes. Time to head over to training, I 
guess.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That banner at the bike shop across the 
street... N-No mistake about it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The transcendent masterpiece etched into 
motorcycle legend! If it isn't a reissue 
model of the 'JUV1331'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn, this is awesome... It's too awesome! 
I gotta go feast my eyes on that majestic 
sight right now!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Ooooh! A body gleaming in dull silver, 
such an overwhelming presence...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Way too cool...! It's the best!! It's on a 
whole other level compared to the catalog 
photos!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A chance like this rarely comes along. 
I've gotta burn this into my retinas...!!

Glued to the motorcycle of her dreams, 
Vodka ended up neglecting her training...
